long_biography.plain_text:
Medialthea gives Maria Francesca Angelini's interest in care a public institution in Monaco. She founded the association in 2021 to support children and young people, particularly through health assistance, education and improved living conditions. It works with local organisations to give its programmes a practical reach across several regions.

Earlier, Angelini presided over the pharmaceutical company built by her family. Beyond that role, she developed a personal wellbeing retail concept. Its shops brought personal-care products and treatments to stations, airports, motorway stops and shopping centres. She now serves as Medialthea's president as well as its founder.
